---
title: "Extend from current data to Moritz"
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
```

Assume that we have the following model: start from the dots, project to the y-axis. This corresponds to the model xxx that we've fit. 

We will first read in the stimuli data from Mortiz experiment 2: 

```{r}
exp_json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(here("data", "moritz", "stimuli", "exp2-stimuli.json" )) %>% as_tibble(.)

stimuli_df <- exp_json_data %>% select(index, seed, noise, flip, type, data) %>% 
    mutate(noise = as.character(noise))
```

Let us from the simple case where index == 0: 

```{r}
stimuli_df %>% filter(index == 0) %>% 
    unnest(data) %>% 
    rename(data_x = x, data_y = y)
```
